Temple donation theft cases investigated in Ayodhya and Badrinath

Investigations are underway into alleged donation theft cases at the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya and the Badrinath temple. In Ayodhya, police have taken two individuals, Tinnu Yadav and Manish Yadav, into custody for questioning regarding the Ram Mandir donations. Separately, in Badrinath, CCTV footage has provided crucial evidence in the investigation of offerings theft.
